summary: Name sign is NAME followed by SIGN. A name sign is a personal sign given to you by Deaf people, used instead of fingerspelling your name.
steps: Sign NAME: H hands, the top one tapping twice on the bottom.
Sign SIGN: index fingers circling alternately.
To ask someone's, follow with YOU and a questioning face.
note: Do not make up your own name sign. They are given by Deaf people, usually after they know you. Until then, fingerspelling your name is correct and expected.
mistakes: Inventing a name sign for yourself. In Deaf culture that's a faux pas.
